page.notes: Left margin notes, as printed: "Coroloft. libello germanico de execrabili Eucharistiæ abusu pag. 1." and "Tom. 2. epist. pag. 56." The note "Tom. 2. epist. pag. 56." appears twice beside the lines; the lower one is printed beside "gister". The word "Rectorem" was printed "Re-ctorem" with the hyphen at the line end; the running head is "Annus MDXXI". Printed text was read with some uncertainty in the margin notes, and the final line "iam" is the catchword-like continuation at the right.
